item.title: Legacy in Motion: Founder’s Week events

item.title: A true Polar Plunge
item.description: “On Saturday, Feb. 7, Butler Ambassadors for Special Olympics (BASO) will host its 27th annual Polar Plunge at the Health and Recreation Complex (HRC).”

item.title: Beyond the box score: Bulldogs drop double-overtime grinder against Providence
item.description: “The Dawgs would start the final period of the night scoreless as Providence strided out to a 10-0 run in 2OT, as they began to lose the war of attrition with Ajayi, Haywood and redshirt-sophomore forward Jamie Kaiser Jr. each fouling out during the extra time.”

item.title: Beyond the box score: Women’s basketball falters after halftime against Villanova
item.description: “‘..The problem is, in the second half, we don't follow the scouting report and turn the basketball over, and so we make life easy for the other team.’”
